## Problem and outcome

Describe the observable problem and the result of this change.

## Technical decisions

Explain the owning module, alternatives considered, compatibility impact, and relevant security/concurrency/persistence trade-offs.

## Verification

List exact commands and tests run. Note anything intentionally not run.

## Documentation and safety

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and failure path.
- [ ] Public interfaces, configuration, schema, persistence, and module README are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private account files, session data, runtime caches, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Planned behavior is not described as implemented.
